request.title: Elara fights at last
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: the besieged town of Muttonham in a blizzard at night, a battered wooden gate and barricades, trolls hammering at the gate, fires burning. Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour, holding a pair of daggers; beside him, summoned for the first time, stands the shadow of his lost sister Elara, a slender figure made of living darkness with faint violet light, a woman's silhouette. Durzo is looking at her with an expression of utter exasperation rather than awe. Epic battle, comedic undertone.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Durzo. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: Durzo fights beside the shadow of his sister Elara at Muttonham's gate in a blizzard, looking deeply unimpressed with her.
